verdict.rationale: Riveter's marketing says the hosted service "reads PDFs and images," and its scrape endpoint turns a URL into parseable text, so PDF extraction without self-hosting is claimed. That claim is a single thin mention, and there is no documented extraction endpoint for files. missing for 10: Word/DOCX support, Excel/XLSX support, PowerPoint/PPTX support, a documented file-upload or document-extraction API with output format details, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract text content from PDFs, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without hosting them myself

citations.quote: It reads PDFs and images, calls third party APIs as part of a workflow
A scrape lets you turn a URL into easily parseable text.
